main.description: Declares that a bidder is willing to submit bids for RFPs whose payload NSID is in appliesTo. The bidder's submitRfp endpoint is given by endpointUrl.

endpointUrl.description: Base URL of the bidder service. POST /xrpc/com.publicdomainrelay.temp.market.submitRfp will be called here.

appliesTo.description: List of payload NSIDs this bidder handles (e.g. com.publicdomainrelay.temp.compute.vm).
